name: golf
description: Highest-quality proprietary mapped golf course dataset. Search is free.
long_description: Golf Intelligence, by Stracka. The highest-quality golf course dataset for developers building a golf app. 20 years of proprietary mapping (laser, drone, airplane, satellite), updated daily. Search is free. Scorecards, GPS, and 3D greens via API. Not a scrape.

GI_ACTIVE_TOKEN.description: Active Token from API Account at https://console.golfintelligence.com/. It is exchanged for a bearer token; do not enter a bearer token.
